page.notes: The Greek phrase after "poteftis," is too small to read reliably; the word after it is only a guess. "sensus" is a guess from the context: the printed word is blurred. "obitet" is uncertain. Small dashes in the left margin near "fortassis" and "hilares" are printer's marks, not text, and are left out. The quotation's opening marks at the start of each line are part of one continuous quotation. The page ends mid-sentence with "sed".
